name: usage-calendar
description: A GitHub-style calendar of your Claude Code usage in a side panel: daily heatmap, live plan limits, context fill per session, tokens and estimated cost.

webUrl.title: Web dashboard link
webUrl.description: Optional. A claude.ai dashboard of the same numbers; the panel shows an "Open on web" link to it.

webRefreshTask.title: Web refresh task id
webRefreshTask.description: Optional. The id of a Claude Code scheduled task that refreshes that dashboard; the panel shows an "Update web too" button that runs it.
